title: Rules-text words
description: The rules text as this language prints it, one entry per ability of the card, paired by ability_id with the card's structure. An ability's text is the sequence of pieces the printed ability consists of: the words are strings, and every part that is a component (a mana symbol, a keyword) is a reference to that component's ID, so the component holds itself once in its list.

ability_id.description: The ability_id of the ability this text belongs to in the card.

text.description: The pieces of that ability's printed words in this language. A plain string is the words; a piece of kind symbol is the mana symbol that ID names in the mana-symbol list. For an activated ability, the words after the cost's colon (CR 602.1a): the card holds the cost, and the printed symbol for it is assembled from the card (CR 107.7 for the loyalty symbol).

id.description: The ID of a mana symbol in the mana-symbol list of this language.
